title: Gate Execution Log Entry
description: Per-gate execution log entry. Written to .zeus/gates/session-YYYYMMDD.jsonl. Used by Self-Improvement Agent for metrics analysis. See Part IV of cursor-kit-v2-FINAL.md.

gate_id.description: G0=contract exists, G1=compiles, G2=Javadoc, G3=coverage>=85%, G4=no hardcoded values, G5=CSRF, G6=role-based access, G7=no secrets, G8=img alt text.

method.description: How the gate was evaluated (e.g., 'mvn compile exit code', 'regex scan', 'AST parse').

details.description: Additional context on failure or escalation.
